entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Ugh, finally. I need to return something.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. I can certainly help you with a return. Do you have your order number handy?
Yeah, it's VF88602. I assume you can look it up.

Yes, of course. One moment... Okay, I see the order here for the VeloFit Aero helmet. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Does it matter? It's the color. It looked brighter on the website.
I understand. So it's a preference issue with the color, not a defect with the helmet itself. Thank you for clarifying.
Whatever. The box is still unopened, if that helps speed this up.
I appreciate you letting me know. Let me just pull up the policy for this item... Okay, I see your delivery was 49 days ago. You're well within our 90-day return window.
So you'll actually take it back?

Absolutely. Ensuring you're happy with the look and safety features of your gear is important to us. I've just approved the return in our system. I am sending you a prepaid return label to the email on file right now.
Fine. How long for the money?
Once our warehouse receives the helmet, your refund will be issued to the original payment method in about 3 to 5 business days.
Great. Is there anything else you need from me or are we done here?
That's everything. The email with the label is on its way. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
